import MumfordLib.SingularCochains
import Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet.Subcomplex
import Mathlib.Topology.Category.TopCat.EpiMono

/-!
# Singular simplices subordinate to a family of subsets

The singular simplices lying in a subset form the range of the singular map
induced by the subtype inclusion. Taking the supremum over a family gives its
small singular simplicial set and a canonical map of integral chain complexes.
The comparison of small chains with all singular chains for an open cover is
not proved here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable (X : TopCat)

/-- The continuous inclusion of a subset with its induced topology. -/
def singularSubsetInclusion (U : Set X) : TopCat.of U ⟶ X :=
  TopCat.ofHom ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩

instance (U : Set X) : Mono (singularSubsetInclusion X U) :=
  (TopCat.mono_iff_injective _).2 Subtype.val_injective

/-- The simplicial subset of singular simplices whose entire image lies in `U`. -/
def singularSubset (U : Set X) : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex :=
  SSet.Subcomplex.range (TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X U))

instance (U : Set X) : Mono (TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X U)) := by
  rw [NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app]
  intro n
  rw [CategoryTheory.mono_iff_injective]
  intro σ τ h
  apply ((TopCat.of U).toSSetObjEquiv n).injective
  ext t
  exact congrArg (fun ξ ↦ X.toSSetObjEquiv n ξ t) h

/-- Membership in the singular subset is the usual whole-simplex image condition. -/
theorem mem_singularSubset_iff (U : Set X) (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ)
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj n) :
    σ ∈ (singularSubset X U).obj n ↔
      ∀ t, X.toSSetObjEquiv n σ t ∈ U := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨τ, rfl⟩ t
    exact ((TopCat.of U).toSSetObjEquiv n τ t).property
  · intro h
    let τ : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n.unop.len + 1)), U) :=
      ⟨fun t ↦ ⟨X.toSSetObjEquiv n σ t, h t⟩,
        (X.toSSetObjEquiv n σ).continuous.subtype_mk h⟩
    refine ⟨((TopCat.of U).toSSetObjEquiv n).symm τ, ?_⟩
    apply (X.toSSetObjEquiv n).injective
    ext t
    change (((TopCat.of U).toSSetObjEquiv n)
      (((TopCat.of U).toSSetObjEquiv n).symm τ) t).val = _
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl

/-- The singular set of a subset identifies with its canonical singular subcomplex. -/
def singularSubsetIso (U : Set X) :
    TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of U) ≅ (singularSubset X U).toSSet := by
  let f := TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X U)
  letI : Mono f := inferInstance
  letI : Mono (SSet.Subcomplex.toRange f) :=
    mono_of_mono_fac (SSet.Subcomplex.toRange_ι f)
  have hIso : IsIso (SSet.Subcomplex.toRange f) := isIso_of_mono_of_epi _
  exact @CategoryTheory.asIso SSet _ _ _ (SSet.Subcomplex.toRange f) hIso

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem singularSubsetIso_hom_ι (U : Set X) :
    (singularSubsetIso X U).hom ≫ (singularSubset X U).ι =
      TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X U) := rfl

theorem singularSubset_mono {U V : Set X} (h : U ⊆ V) :
    singularSubset X U ≤ singularSubset X V := by
  intro n σ hσ
  exact (mem_singularSubset_iff X V n σ).2
    (fun t ↦ h ((mem_singularSubset_iff X U n σ).1 hσ t))

@[simp]
theorem singularSubset_univ : singularSubset X Set.univ = ⊤ := by
  ext n σ
  simp [mem_singularSubset_iff]

@[simp]
theorem singularSubset_inter (U V : Set X) :
    singularSubset X (U ∩ V) = singularSubset X U ⊓ singularSubset X V := by
  ext n σ
  simp only [mem_singularSubset_iff, Subfunctor.min_obj, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  exact forall_and

/-- The small singular simplicial set for a family of subsets. A simplex belongs
when its entire image lies in one member of the family. -/
def smallSingularSubcomplex {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X) :
    (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex :=
  ⨆ i, singularSubset X (U i)

@[simp]
theorem mem_smallSingularSubcomplex_iff {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X)
    (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj n) :
    σ ∈ (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).obj n ↔
      ∃ i, ∀ t, X.toSSetObjEquiv n σ t ∈ U i := by
  simp [smallSingularSubcomplex, mem_singularSubset_iff]

theorem singularSubset_le_smallSingularSubcomplex {ι : Type*}
    (U : ι → Set X) (i : ι) :
    singularSubset X (U i) ≤ smallSingularSubcomplex X U :=
  le_iSup (fun i ↦ singularSubset X (U i)) i

/-- Integral chains on the singular simplices subordinate to a family. -/
abbrev IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X) :
    ChainComplex (ModuleCat ℤ) ℕ :=
  (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).toSSet.chainComplex (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)

/-- The inclusion of small singular chains into the original singular complex. -/
def smallSingularChainInclusion {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X) :
    IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U ⟶ IntegralSingularChainComplex X :=
  SSet.chainComplexMap (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).ι (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem smallSingularChainInclusion_simplex {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X)
    {n : ℕ} (σ : (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).toSSet.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).toSSet.ιChainComplex σ ≫
        (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n = singularSimplexChain σ.val :=
  SSet.ι_chainComplexMap_f _ _ (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).ι (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) σ

/- The inclusion remains monic after passing to integral chains in every
degree. This is the degreewise injectivity needed when comparing small and
ordinary singular chains. -/
theorem smallSingularChainInclusion_mono_f {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    Mono ((smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n) := by
  have hσn : Mono ((CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaConst.obj (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map
      ((smallSingularSubcomplex X U).ι.app (op ⦋n⦌))) := by
    apply Functor.map_mono
  exact hσn

end Mumford.Analytic
